sectionSubtitle: Read authentic feedback from artists who completed our mentorship cohorts and fashion ateliers who commissioned bespoke works.

testimonials.name: Kavya Singhania
testimonials.content: Before House of Kalakaar, digital illustration felt flat. Vrinda's brush alchemy and drapery lighting transformed how I sketch my collections.

testimonials.name: Tanya Sengupta
testimonials.content: The Banarasi zardozi techniques I learned allowed me to charge 3x for bespoke bridal stationery lookbooks. Outstanding mentorship.

testimonials.name: Simran Ahuja
testimonials.content: Transitioning from canvas to iPad was intimidating. Vrinda's patience and tactile brush settings made it feel like working on real textured paper.

testimonials.name: Pooja Deshmukh
testimonials.content: Hands-down the best Procreate fashion masterclass in India. The step-by-step layer deconstruction method is pure gold.
